_comment: ComfyUI API-format image-to-video workflow on this PC's Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B (C:/Users/MORR/ComfyUI/models: diffusion_models/wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16.safetensors, vae/wan2.2_vae.safetensors, text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors), all native ComfyUI nodes (0.18.1), no custom nodes. The settings are the ones a run on this PC already proved in June 2026 (ComfyUI/output/done_pretending_wan22_hq: 81 frames at 1280x704, 16 steps, about 2.5 minutes a clip). src/assets/localvideo.ts substitutes exactly five inputs before queueing it: node 1 inputs.image (the uploaded start picture, 'subfolder/name'), node 6 inputs.text (the motion prompt), node 7 inputs.text (the fixed negative), node 9 inputs.seed and node 12 inputs.filename_prefix. Everything else is fixed here. length must be 4n+1; 81 frames at 16 fps is 5.06 s. The model's native rate is 24 fps (121 frames for 5 s), about 1.6x the time; 16 fps is smooth enough for a slow push-in under narration and Remotion plays it at the composition's 30 fps.
